headline: Wembanyama’s 32 gets the Spurs back on track
dek: Victor Wembanyama scored 32 and Stephon Castle added 21 and 12 assists as San Antonio bounced back from Tuesday’s loss.
three: 13 of 26 from the field, his seventh 30-point game of the season.
Spurs up 3 at the half, then won the fourth 32–24
Wembanyama, Castle and Champagnie combined for 73 of 124.
Won it in the paint and with the extra pass
Points in the paint 54–36; assists 37–24. San Antonio had 15 steals to the Clippers’ 11.
